abstract: PURPOSE: In order to investigate the role of potentially lethal damage repair (PLDR) in cellular radiosensitivity, PLDR and its inhibitory effect by caffeine was examined. In addition, cell cycle distribution was also examined. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Two rat yolk sac tumor cell lines, NMT-1 and NMT-1R, with different radiosensitivities in vitro were used. The capacity for PLDR was examined using confluent-phase cells, and evaluated by calculating the recovery ratio. Inhibitory effect of caffeine on PLDR was examined with doses of 1, 5 and 10 mM. RESULTS: The capacity of PLDR in two cell lines reflected radiosensitivity. The recovery ratio after irradiation of 5 Gy was 2.8 in the radiosensitive NMT-1 and 5.2 in the radioresistant NMT-1R, and recovery reached its peak level at 6 h in both cell lines. The degree of inhibition of PLDR was weaker in NMT-1R than that in NMT-1 at the same dose level, and was correlated with reduction of G2-arrested cells by caffeine. CONCLUSIONS: The results of this study suggest that the capacity of PLDR may be one of the determinant factors for radiosensitivity in the two cell lines used, and the inhibitory effect of caffeine on PLDR was in part attributable to the modification of the cell cycle progression.
abstract_ja: 目的：潜在致死損傷修復（PLDR）が細胞の放射線感受性に果たす役割を検討するため、PLDRとカフェインによるその抑制効果を調べた。また細胞周期分布も検討した。方法：放射線感受性が異なる2種のラット卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株NMT-1とNMT-1Rを用いた。PLDRの能力は、コンフルエント期の細胞を用いて評価し、回復比を算出した。カフェインのPLDRに対する抑制効果は1、5、10 mMの用量で検討した。結果：2株のPLDR能は放射線感受性を反映していた。5Gy照射後の回復比は放射線感受性株NMT-1で2.8、放射線耐性株NMT-1Rで5.2であり、回復は両株とも6時間で最大に達した。同一用量におけるPLDRの抑制の程度はNMT-1Rでより弱く、カフェインによるG2期停止細胞の減少と相関していた。結論：PLDR能は、用いた2株の放射線感受性を決定する因子の一つである可能性があり、カフェインのPLDR抑制効果は、細胞周期の進行の修飾によるところが一部あると考えられる。
